scope: Development data only. Original and redesigned arms use the same model and generation settings. No fourth-document cases.

other_selection.basis: Inclusive numeric range on a supplied sidewalk width. Existing comparison and conjunction operators suffice under the frozen scope; exterior inventory/evidence is still required.
Reserved-stall count ratio. Existing count, arithmetic and comparison operators suffice under the frozen scope; declared inventory/evidence is still required.
Adapted-seat count ratio. Existing count, arithmetic and comparison operators suffice under the frozen scope; declared inventory/evidence is still required.

interpretation: Executable under the frozen manual scope means expressible with existing primitives and supplied evidence. It does not assert that the current extraction catalogue already contains all required bindings.
thermal_gate: After both arms complete all five thermal cases, pause before any later phase if neither retains a rule. Diagnose terminal stages and record a reviewed checkpoint before spending more quota.
